offline_movement.description: S2 must show a non-degenerate learning signal relative to S1. These are diagnostic gates only and are not strength evidence.
offline_movement.pass_condition: At least one offline metric must meet its minimum improvement threshold, and no offline metric may exceed its maximum regression threshold.

competitive_movement.description: Fresh multi-seed Arena screen comparing the S2 checkpoint against the S1 checkpoint, with M07 and heuristic anchors. This is the strength-evidence layer.

pass_condition.s2_vs_s1: S2 must have a strictly positive pairwise score lower bound against S1 in the fresh multi-seed screen.
pass_condition.anchors: S2 must not show a material regression against M07 or heuristic relative to S1's anchor results; max allowed anchor regression is 200 bps.

decision.pass_means: S2 shows a non-degenerate offline learning signal and a positive competitive movement against S1 without anchor regression; S3 may be considered.
decision.fail_means: S2 fails offline movement or competitive movement; stop M24 scaling and do not auto-authorize M25.
